answer_1.quote: We compile and release MRBench ... each instance includes a partial conversation between a tutor and a student ... we generated responses from seven state-of-the-art LLMs acting as tutors.
answer_1.outputs: Tutor responses aimed at remediating student mistakes in mathematical dialogues.

answer_2.quote: We utilize two key metrics to quantitatively assess the pedagogical effectiveness of LLMs ... (1) Desired Annotation Match Rate (DAMR) ... (2) Annotation Correlation (AC).

answer_3.quote: We also used two LLMs as evaluators: • We used Prometheus2 ... • In addition, we also used Llama-3.1-8B as a lightweight LLM to assess the reliability of smaller models ...
methods: Prompt-based scoring of the eight taxonomy dimensions

answer_4.quote: Four trained annotators ... annotated MRBench using the validated taxonomy. Each annotator was asked to annotate ... across 8 dimensions using a three-tier labeling system.
answer_4.guideline: Annotation guidelines with three-tier labels (yes, to some extent, no) for each of the eight dimensions.
